name: How long does a surgical error lawsuit typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a surgical error lawsuit typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a surgical error lawsuit can vary significantly depending on the complexity of the case, the severity of the injuries, the willingness of all parties to negotiate, and court schedules. Some cases may settle within a year, while others, particularly those that go to trial, can take several years to resolve. Your lawyer will work to move your case forward efficiently while ensuring all necessary steps are taken to build a strong claim. They can provide a more specific estimate after thoroughly reviewing the details of your situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Surgical error lawsuits vary in length, often taking one to several years depending on complexity and willingness to settle.
